title: Cú đêm
about: Round x17 (album 12), the user: "hãy sáng tác album tiếp theo": sleep music in the style of Sleep in the Dark (ngu-ngon), on a less common progression of its own (template 3; after the Content ID matches on plain i-VI-iv-V pieces), slow (52 bpm), strings, pad, sub, an improvised felt tune, then box. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece.
